note: Budgets of the Meta Quest build. Read by scripts/godot/check_budgets.py (sections apk, pck, tree; it also validates every section, scene and audio included) and godot/tools/measure_budgets.gd (sections scene, audio). Kept outside godot/ so the file does not ship in the APK; check_budgets.py --tree fails if a second copy appears at godot/data/apk-budgets.json. A limit is changed only in the same PR as docs/APK_REQUIREMENTS.md, with the reason.

exception_policy.why: An exception is a known breach recorded with its blocker in docs/APK_REQUIREMENTS.md and its approval: 'pending: ...' until the operator decides, then 'operator: <PR or date>'. Both gates refuse an exception without these fields or above 5x its base limit: past that it is another budget, changed only with a chorus line. The list of exceptions only shrinks without the operator's word.

total_bytes.why: 128 MiB: engine and runtime are 89,483,440 B (lib + dex) and fixed; the branch APK of CI run 78 is 100,820,608 B; about 13% of the Meta Store limit of 1 GB

native_libs_bytes.why: 84 MiB: four .so of Godot 4.7.1 debug + vendors 5.1.0 are 83,393,888 B; a second ABI or a new native plugin trips it

dex_bytes.why: 8 MiB: classes*.dex are 6,089,552 B; only a new Java/Kotlin plugin makes them grow

assets_bytes.why: 32 MiB of game content (assets/ or PCK, uncompressed): about 2.9x the 11,657,414 B of assets/ in the branch APK of CI run 78

largest_asset_bytes.why: 1 MiB per file: the largest JSON book, apostol-ru-sinod (743,528 B), took 8,273,496 B of heap to parse; a larger single file is a frame hitch

min_assets_entries.why: floor: build 44 has 549 files in assets/; far fewer means the export lost the game, and a gate that passes an empty APK measured nothing

min_files.why: floor for --pck: the same content as assets/ in the APK; an empty or near-empty pack is a broken export, not a small one

content_bytes.why: 32 MiB of source over every file the export packs (all folders, not only art/models/data); the same ceiling as assets_bytes

largest_resource_bytes.why: same as apk.largest_asset_bytes, checked on the source before the build

min_models.why: floor: 145 .glb today; a gate that counts no models checked no triangles

min_exported_files.why: floor: 446 exported files today; a gate that sees no files checked nothing

model_triangles.why: CLAUDE.md TABOO 0.32 p.4: a proxy is at most 5,000 triangles; counted in .glb and .gltf, and a model in .obj/.fbx/.dae/.blend is a breach because the gate cannot count it

models/rov/mangustik.glb.why: docs/HLD_MANGUSTIK_COCKPIT_2026-09-30.md M2 and scripts/meta3d/mangustik_rov.py MAX_TRIANGLES = 20000 (whole vehicle). Conflicts with TABOO 0.32 p.4
models/rov/mangustik.glb.approval: pending: operator decides (simplify to 5,000 or allow in the rule); set by the HLD, not by the operator

draw_calls_frame.why: the project's own choice, stricter than Meta's load-dependent ranges: Meta recommends < 100 for Quest 2 and < 200 for Quest 3 (device-optimization-comparison), and export_presets.cfg has quest_2_support=true. Counted over the whole frame: the main view (one call covers both eyes under multiview) and every SubViewport, 3D and canvas. Known breaches are exceptions until blocker Б-1 is lifted; a new call above them turns CI red

hub.why: measured 438 (courtyard, 437 main 3D + 1 canvas), llvmpipe 1280x720; ratchet: may only go down
hub.approval: pending: operator decides on Quest 2; developer merges meshes (Б-1)

dive.why: measured 255 (depth-3m: main 3D 149 + canvas 4 + three SubViewports 102), llvmpipe 1280x720; ratchet: may only go down
dive.approval: pending: operator decides on Quest 2; developer merges meshes (Б-1)

witness.why: measured 129 (start), llvmpipe 1280x720; ratchet: may only go down
witness.approval: pending: operator decides on Quest 2; developer merges meshes (Б-1)

primitives_two_eyes_est.why: Quest 2 recommendation (< 750K triangles per frame). Whether Meta counts per eye or both eyes is unknown, so the estimate is the conservative one: 2 x main-view primitives + all SubViewports; the one-view figure is reported beside it

static_memory_delta_bytes.why: 64 MiB of CPU heap over the engine baseline per scene: about 2.9x the worst scene (hub, about 23 MB, measure_budgets.gd method)

texture_memory_over_empty_bytes.why: 32 MiB of texture memory above an empty 3D scene at the same size and MSAA (content, fonts, SubViewports)

subviewport_bytes.why: 4 MiB of SubViewport render targets; measured 8 B/px on the host

script_ms_mean_host.why: a quarter of the 72 Hz frame (13.89 ms) for the scene's own _process on the host, net of run-queue wait (close to CPU time); Quest core speed is unknown

script_ms_max_host.why: half of the 72 Hz frame on the host, net of run-queue wait

script_host_max_load_per_core.why: time is not judged when the host's one-minute load per core is above this when the run begins: at 1.2-1.35 per core five dive runs gave a mean of 2.68-3.05 ms; at 2.3-3.1 per core the mean reached 4.38 ms and the peak 35 ms (docs/APK_REQUIREMENTS.md, row 17)

audio_generators.why: at most two synths fed by the CPU per scene; dive and witness have one each (dive_audio.gd, witness.gd)

device.why: measured only on the headset (OVR Metrics Tool, dumpsys meminfo); 2 GiB PSS is under half of the Quest 2 limit of 4.4 GiB

synth_ms_per_second_host.why: 5% of one host core per second of audio, net of run-queue wait; see docs/APK_REQUIREMENTS.md row 15 for the measured medians

pcm_clips_bytes.why: 16 MiB of float32 bell clips in RAM, checked against the worst two consecutive days of a year's Typikon plan (clips are kept once made, so a stay across a day boundary holds both days)

audio.checked_by: godot/tools/measure_budgets.gd --check, headless (the revisor; not in CI, since time does not reproduce on a shared runner)
